projection.axes: x east, y north (map north is +y; in three.js use (x, 0, -y) for a y-up world)
projection.formula: x = round((lon - origin.lon) * metresPerDegLon / metresPerUnit); y = round((lat - origin.lat) * metresPerDegLat / metresPerUnit)

methodKey.postgis: point of the Planning record in the local PostGIS copy (public.applications, source datasf_planning)
methodKey.eas: address matched in DataSF Enterprise Addressing System (3mea-di5p)
methodKey.eas-near: house number not listed; nearest listed number on the same block and side
methodKey.centreline: interpolated along the street centreline address range (3psu-pn9h)
methodKey.none: no coordinate (x, y are null; see note)

fields: x, y: address point, in street units (null when not located). sx, sy: nearest point on the street network in sf-streets.bin, on the address's own street where it could be matched. offStreetM: distance between the two, metres. Several motions can share one address, so positions repeat.
